Definition: to tire; (figuratively) to be (or make) disgusted
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be weary, be impatient, be grieved, be offended; 1a) (Qal) to be weary, be impatient; 1b) (Niphal) to be tired of something, weary oneself; 1c) (Hiphil) to weary, make weary, exhaust
